Scriberman 1.0.5

What’s new

  • Organize recordings with customizable color tags.
  • Assign tags from a recording’s context menu or detail toolbar, then filter the recording list with tag chips.
  • Interrupted audio capture now resumes automatically without losing audio already recorded.
  • Recording rows now warn when capture was interrupted or some audio segments may be missing.

Fixes

  • Improved audio alignment when capture buffers are dropped or fail to write.
  • Fixed tag controls that could appear empty, do nothing, or leave users stuck in a filtered list.
